a.lede: The FBI has confirmed that North Korean state-sponsored hackers known as TraderTraitor were behind the $6.3 billion crypto-theft attack on Binance, making it the largest cryptocurrency heist on record. [...]
a.title: FBI links $6.3 billion Binance crypto heist to North Korean hackers

b.lede: Cryptocurrency exchange scrambles to freeze affected assets, with about $3bn located so far The world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange has been hit by an industry-record $6.3bn (£4.7bn) hack, with experts identifying North Korea as the likely culprit. b.title: North Korean group blamed for $6.3bn Binance hack in biggest ever crypto heist
